newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Olympic Airways begins Athens-Moscow route.
newsitem.headline: Olympic Airways begins Athens-Moscow route.

text.p: Greek state-owned Olympic Airways will begin regular passenger flights between Athens and Moscow three times a week from March 23, a senior company official said on Friday
Georgios Sinanidis, Olympic Airways general manager in Russia, said the company would operate 156-seat Boeing 737-400s on the route.
The airline will fly from Moscow's Sheremetyevo-2 airport on Tuesdays, Thursdays and Sundays. This schedule is effective until June 21.
Sinanidis said Olympic hoped to atract Russian tourists.
Russian flagship carrier Aeroflot makes three passenger flights a week between Moscow and Athens.
